item.name: 10 - UAT Demo Walkthrough (Questionnaire-Aligned)
item.description: Aligned to the 'User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Questionnaire - SDG Recycling Ecosystem Backend'. Run this folder top-to-bottom for one UAT session using a real live tester account instead of creating throwaway demo users. Before the session, set uatTesterEmail and uatTesterPassword in the active Postman environment. The setup step logs in that tester, stores studentToken and uatStudentUserId, and guards against accidentally switching tester IDs mid-session. Create or choose one dedicated active UAT mission, then set uatMissionId; the included 'Setup: Create Dedicated UAT Mission - Admin' request is a sample you can run once at the start of a session. The folder captures baseline points/submissions, performs student/admin actions, and then reads fresh API data back so the UAT evidence reflects real-time state changes. If the same tester reruns the same one-submission mission, duplicate submission checks may correctly return 409; use a fresh UAT mission or clear the tester's UAT submission for a fully fresh submit-and-approve walkthrough.
